items.quote: Had a special private dinner for my wife and I at our house in Saratoga Springs. What an amazing meal and experience! Would highly recommend!

Chef Isa and John prepared an incredible meal for our private dinner party. The food was fresh and flavorful. The presentation was beautiful as well. Chef Isa worked her magic in the kitchen and John assisted with the explanation of the meal.

We had the privilege of being the first clients coming back from New York to Florida and it did not disappoint at all. Everyone says it so often that pretty soon it will be their permanent slogan; its 100% true, "SOOO good".
